purpose: Fresh confirmation of asymmetric FAR-Cal after redesign and development
sample_size_basis: Development episode SDs were 1.3065 and 1.1692 with effects 0.8122 and 0.7981; normal-approximation minimum sizes were 10 and 9. Forty fresh balanced episodes were fixed for conservative confirmation.
inference: Average paired effects across model and fault seeds within each episode, then bootstrap the 40 complete episodes with 2000 resamples.
superiority_rule: Both comparator-minus-candidate 95% episode-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero and candidate aggregate 90% coverage must be at least 0.88.
data_boundary: No episode with seed 70001 through 70040 existed in the validation directory when this registry was committed.
